text.tspan: S3 event notifications: direct targets or EventBridge
Permissions are RESOURCE policies on the target:
One policy per destination, allowing S3 to push.
Not an IAM role on S3.
Filter by name, e.g. suffix .jpg (prefix / suffix).
As many events as you want; typically delivered
in seconds, sometimes a minute or longer.
• Advanced filtering with JSON rules (metadata, object size, name...). • Multiple destinations per event.
• EventBridge capabilities: archive, replay events, reliable delivery.
• Turn it on once per bucket: every S3 event goes to EventBridge (you don't pick event types on the S3 side).
• Direct S3 notifications: one destination type per notification configuration; SQS FIFO and SNS FIFO are NOT supported targets.
